description: Effacements quotidiens sur le mécanisme d'ajustement (2013 à 2024) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Historique quotidien des capacités d’effacement de consommation d’électricité (MW) sur le mécanisme d’ajustement. Offre minimum disponible sur la journée Offre moyenne disponible sur la journée Offre maximum disponible sur la journée Effacement maximum activé sur la journée. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Marchés. Its keywords are Bilan annuel. The portal shows 2026-03-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
